why_best: It bridges abstract UI concepts with tangible physical hardware, giving executive audiences an immediate sense of tactile luxury and technical sophistication.
why_bad: A flat, two-dimensional presentation of the interface would feel like a standard wireframe, stripping away the visual prestige required for high-stakes executive visual beats.
trap: A common failure point is treating the dynamic surface materials as opaque overlays, which destroys the realistic light transmission passing through the interface layers.
